title: MAGNET: Manifold-Aware Graph Diffusion Network for Connectome Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.17014v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Functional brain connectome represents neural connectivity as a matrix of pairwise interactions between brain regions. Generation of functional connectomes is not only a question of validity; rather, having satisfied the constraints on the correlation matrix, the next step is to recover the class-conditional geometry buried under coarse labels. We propose MAGNET, a Manifold-Aware Graph Diffusion Network which uses a normalized-Cholesky representation of the manifold of correlation matrices that guarantees validity. MAGNET lifts noisy latent states into ROI-level region tokens and performs denoising with a relational inductive bias over brain atlas regions. To deal with structural problems induced by coarse labels, MAGNET employs class-anchored conditioning, amortized structural bridge, and relevance-preserving corruption. Across ABIDE, ADNI, and OASIS-3, MAGNET consistently achieves favorable results compared to previous manifold-aware

translated_title: MAGNET：用于连接组生成的流形感知图扩散网络
translated_abstract: 功能脑连接组将神经连接表示为脑区之间成对相互作用的矩阵。功能连接组的生成不仅仅是有效性问题；在满足相关矩阵的约束条件之后，下一步是恢复隐藏在粗粒度标签之下的类条件几何结构。我们提出了MAGNET，一种流形感知图扩散网络，它使用相关矩阵流形的归一化Cholesky表示来保证有效性。MAGNET将带噪声的潜在状态提升为ROI级别的区域标记，并通过在脑图谱区域上的关系归纳偏置进行去噪。为了处理粗粒度标签引起的结构问题，MAGNET采用了类锚定条件化、摊销结构桥接和相关性保持破坏机制。在ABIDE、ADNI和OASIS-3数据集上，MAGNET相比之前的流形感知方法始终取得了更优的结果。
tldr: 提出MAGNET流形感知图扩散网络，通过归一化Cholesky表示保证相关矩阵有效性，并结合类锚定条件化、摊销结构桥接和相关性保持破坏技术，从粗粒度标签中恢复类条件几何结构以生成高质量功能脑连接组。
en_tdlr: MAGNET is a manifold-aware graph diffusion network that guarantees valid correlation matrices via a normalized-Cholesky representation and employs class-anchored conditioning, amortized structural bridging, and relevance-preserving corruption to recover class-conditional geometry for functional connectome generation.
